description: Fuselage only of C-47A-20-DK c/n 13056 (ex USAAF 42-93174, Panagra NC88726), FAA T-50 from May 1947, withdrawn after a 1952 forced landing at Córdoba and used for decades as a static parachute-training platform; re-erected on the brigade perimeter in all-grey with Ejército Argentino 'Escuela de Tropas Aerotransportadas' titles and the fictitious code ETA-1 (reported December 2024).
museum_name: IV Brigada Aerotransportada Córdoba C-47 Fuselage
